```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

This notebook connects to Supabase as the read-only `analyst` login and
loads every table the app's data feeds into R:

- `households_flat`: one row per household and season, the same columns as
  the app's CSV export (inputs and every calculated result). Each household
  and season is counted once (latest upload, see `supabase/schema.sql`).
- `raw_*`: one table per repeating part of the questionnaire (plots, cocoa
  sales by month, inputs, labour by month, spending, "Doesn't know"
  answers). Join to `households_flat` on `household_id`.
- `households_duplicates`: uploads set aside because a newer record exists
  for the same coop, member code and season.

**Before knitting:** the connection is read from `Documents\.Renviron`
(`PGHOST`, `PGPORT`, `PGDATABASE`, `PGUSER`, `PGPASSWORD`), never from this
file. In Supabase, `schema.sql` and then `raw_views.sql` must have been run
(19.11.26 version or later). Packages, once:
`install.packages(c("DBI", "RPostgres", "rmarkdown"))`.

## Connection check

```{r connection}
library(DBI)
stopifnot("PGUSER is empty: check Documents/.Renviron and restart R" = nzchar(Sys.getenv("PGUSER")))
Sys.getenv(c("PGHOST", "PGDATABASE", "PGUSER"))
```

## Load the tables

`load_all()` comes from `export_raw.R` (same folder): it lists the views on
the server, loads `households_flat` and every `raw_*` view, and adds a
`*_label` column next to each answer code, from `codebook/options.csv`.

```{r load}
source("export_raw.R")
tables <- load_all(labels = TRUE)

con <- dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres(), sslmode = "require")
tables$households_duplicates <- tryCatch(
  dbGetQuery(con, "select * from public.households_duplicates"),
  error = function(e) {
    message("households_duplicates not found: run the 19.11.26 schema.sql in Supabase. Until then households_flat may count a household twice.")
    data.frame()
  }
)
dbDisconnect(con)

# Every table as its own data frame in the session: flat, raw_cocoa_sales, ...
invisible(list2env(tables, envir = globalenv()))
flat <- households_flat
```

## What was loaded

```{r overview}
overview <- data.frame(
  table   = names(tables),
  rows    = vapply(tables, nrow, integer(1)),
  columns = vapply(tables, ncol, integer(1)),
  row.names = NULL
)
knitr::kable(overview)
```

## Households by coop and season

```{r by-coop}
by_coop <- aggregate(
  household_id ~ coop_name + season, data = flat, FUN = length
)
names(by_coop)[3] <- "households"
knitr::kable(by_coop[order(by_coop$coop_name, by_coop$season), ], row.names = FALSE)
```

## Duplicates set aside

```{r duplicates}
if (ncol(households_duplicates) == 0) {
  cat("Not available yet: run the 19.11.26 schema.sql in Supabase.\n")
} else if (nrow(households_duplicates)) {
  knitr::kable(households_duplicates)
} else {
  cat("No duplicates: every coop + member code + season has one upload.\n")
}
```

## Check: cocoa sales from the raw rows match the app's totals

```{r check}
sales <- raw_cocoa_sales
sales$revenue <- sales$volume * sales$price
from_raw <- aggregate(revenue ~ household_id, data = sales, FUN = sum, na.rm = TRUE, na.action = na.pass)
cmp <- merge(flat[, c("household_id", "total_cocoa_sales_revenue")], from_raw, by = "household_id", all.x = TRUE)
cmp$revenue[is.na(cmp$revenue)] <- 0
cat(sum(abs(cmp$total_cocoa_sales_revenue - cmp$revenue) < 0.01, na.rm = TRUE), "of", nrow(cmp),
    "households match the app's cocoa sales total.\n")
```

## Optional: write every table to CSV

Set `out_dir` to a folder to get one CSV per table.

```{r csv}
out_dir <- ""  # e.g. "C:/Users/<you>/Documents/cocoa_export"
if (nzchar(out_dir)) {
  dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  for (n in names(tables)) {
    write.csv(tables[[n]], file.path(out_dir, paste0(n, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
  }
  cat("Written to", normalizePath(out_dir), "\n")
}
```
